lines.en: label chinamispring5:
scene chinamiconfronts1
Fresh off the boat that carried her through seas of somewhat mandatory midday misery, Chinami Chosokabe eventually returns to her apartment to find her “Papa” wearing clothes.
lines.zh: 载着她渡过那片多少有些强制性的午后苦海的船刚靠岸，Chinami Chosokabe 终于回到公寓，发现她的「爸爸」穿着衣服。

lines.en: This was good news. For after the “break” her friend mentioned at the end of the preceding event, there were at least five other bouts of what could only be described as “obnoxious sexual rampage.”
lines.zh: 这算是个好消息。因为在上一件事末尾她朋友提到的那次「休息」之后，至少还发生了另外五轮只能被形容为「令人反感的性爱狂潮」的事。

lines.en: It appeared that the rampage had ended, thankfully. But the sadness had not.
lines.zh: 幸好，那场狂潮似乎结束了。可悲伤没有。

lines.en: There were other feelings as well. Confusion, mostly. The sorts of feelings {i}anyone{/i} would get after watching a little sister take LOADS of cum from the hung guy and his MASSIVE cock for the first time.
lines.zh: 还有别的情绪。主要是困惑。就是{i}任何人{/i}在看一个妹妹第一次被那个家伙用他那根巨屌灌进一大堆精液之后，都会有的那种感觉。

lines.en: But those would fade in time, and the worry of what might soon happen to her friend would not.
lines.zh: 不过这些都会随时间淡去，而对她朋友即将遭遇什么的担忧不会。

lines.en: : Oh...hi.
: Chinami is very disappointed in you, Papa. You have defiled her home.
lines.zh: : Chinami 对你很失望，爸爸。你玷污了她的家。

lines.en: : ...What?
: {i}You know what you did.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你知道你做了什么。{/i}

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts2
: Well...at least now I know how thin the walls are.
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少现在我知道墙有多薄了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry you had to hear that. I needed to repair your sister. Please ignore and forget all of it.
lines.zh: : 抱歉让你听见了。我需要修复你姐姐。请把这些都无视掉、忘掉吧。

lines.en: : Chinami isn’t sure she can. Your actions have caused irreparable damage to her developing mind. You should be ashamed of yourself, Papa.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不确定她做得到。你的行为对她正在发育的心智造成了无法弥补的伤害。你应该感到羞耻，爸爸。

lines.en: : Well, I’ve got great news for you then, Chinami. Because my shame is already infinite and being scolded by a wizard will do nothing but remind me of the walking sin that I have become.
lines.zh: : 那我有个好消息要告诉你，Chinami。因为我的羞耻早就无穷无尽了，被一个巫师训斥，只会让我想起自己已经变成了行走的罪孽。

lines.en: : Where’s big sis Chika? Did you fuck her into oblivion?
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐呢？你把她操到不省人事了吗?

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts3
: Woah. Okay. No more of that. Your sister will kill me if she hears you use that word.
lines.zh: : 哇。好了。别再说了。你姐姐要是听见你说那个词，会杀了我的。

lines.en: : In fact, your sister will kill me if she hears you even mention that you {i}heard{/i} anything. So just do us both a favor and repeat this to no one.
lines.zh: : 事实上，你姐姐要是听见你哪怕提一句你{i}听见了{/i}什么，也会杀了我。所以帮我们俩个忙，别跟任何人说。

lines.en: : It’s big sis Chika’s fault in the first place, Papa. She’s the one who was loud. I heard that word from her while the two of you were {i}studying{/i} in here.
lines.zh: : 一开始就是 Chika 姐姐的错，爸爸。是她叫得太大声。你们俩在屋里{i}学习{/i}的时候，我就是从她那儿听见那个词的。

lines.en: : Still, I’d prefer it if you-
lines.zh: : 即便如此，我还是希望你能——

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts4
: And {i}Chinami{/i} would prefer it if the two of you didn’t lie to her just so you could spend time together. Chinami would have given you space if you asked.
lines.zh: : 可{i}Chinami{/i}更希望，你们俩别为了能独处就对她撒谎。要是你们开口问，Chinami 会让你们有空间的。

lines.en: : {i}Where?{/i} You can’t go anywhere other than Tsukasa’s and that clearly didn’t help at all.
lines.zh: : {i}去哪儿?{/i}你除了 Tsukasa 家没别的地方可去，而且那显然一点用都没有。

lines.en: : Chinami would hide in the bathroom and put loud music on instead.
lines.zh: : Chinami 会躲在浴室里，把音乐开得很大声。

lines.en: : Could you {i}not{/i} put loud music on at Tsukasa’s place?
lines.zh: : 你能{i}别{/i}在 Tsukasa 家把音乐开那么大吗?

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts5
: Chinami wanted to, but Tsukasa wouldn’t let her! She kept listening to you two the whole time and I just had to sit there and hold my ears closed!
lines.zh: : Chinami 想啊，可 Tsukasa 不让!她一直在听你们俩的声音，我只能坐在那儿捂着耳朵!

lines.en: : Wow, this hole just keeps getting bigger. I might not even be able to climb out at this point.
lines.zh: : 哇，这个洞越挖越大。我搞不好已经爬不出来了。

lines.en: : Papa {i}made{/i} this hole when he did it with a girl in Tsukasa’s room!
lines.zh: : 爸爸在 Tsukasa 房间里跟一个女生做的时候，{i}挖了{/i}这个洞!

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts6
: Yup. I’m stuck here forever now. Should’ve just made Chika come to me instead.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我这辈子都困在这儿了。早知道就该让 Chika 自己来找我。

lines.en: : Let the record show that Chinami is not upset about what you did today. She’s just angry that she was lied to and very confused about what happened at Tsukasa’s house.
lines.zh: : 在此声明：Chinami 并不是因为你今天做的事生气。她生气的是你骗了她，而且对 Tsukasa 家发生的事很困惑。

lines.en: : Good. You {i}should{/i} be. But that doesn’t mean I’m going to talk about it with you. Which is why you should drop it and just stay uninvolved.
lines.zh: : 很好。你{i}该{/i}生气。但这不代表我会跟你谈这件事。所以你最好别再问，就当没你的事。

lines.en: : I’ll be more careful with Chika in the future so you don’t have to hear it anymore. And frankly, I’m surprised she wanted to do that stuff {i}here{/i} to begin with {i}because{/i} of you.
lines.zh: : 以后我和 Chika 会小心点，你就不会再听见了。说实话，我很意外她一开始{i}因为{/i}你在，还想在{i}这儿{/i}做那些事。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t want to be a burden like that.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不想成为那样的负担。

lines.en: : You just {i}existing{/i} is not burdensome, Chinami. You haven’t done anything wrong.
lines.zh: : 你{i}活着{/i}本身就不是负担，Chinami。你没做错任何事。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts7
: Chinami never does anything wrong. It’s her job to make life easier for Big Sis Chika. Which is why she talks to you about this stuff instead of her.
lines.zh: : Chinami 从来不会做错事。让 Chika 姐姐过得轻松是她的职责。所以她才会跟你谈这些，而不是跟姐姐谈。

lines.en: : Yeah, well I wish you wouldn’t talk to {i}me{/i} about it either.
lines.zh: : 嗯，可我也希望你别跟{i}我{/i}谈这些。

lines.en: : That leaves Chinami with nobody then.
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 就没人可以谈了。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts8
: She can’t talk to big sis Chika because she’ll get worried. And she can’t talk to {i}Papa{/i} cause he’ll get {i}sad.{/i} So what’s she supposed to do then? Never learn anything?
lines.zh: : 她不能跟 Chika 姐姐说，因为她会担心。也不能跟{i}爸爸{/i}说，因为他会{i}难过{/i}。那她该怎么办？永远什么都学不到?

lines.en: : You’re supposed to {i}wait.{/i} You’re not ready to talk about any of this stuff yet, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 你该{i}等{/i}。你还不到谈这些事的时候，Chinami。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts9
: But Tsukasa {i}is?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可 Tsukasa {i}就行了?{/i}

lines.en: : She never talked about any of that adult stuff until she saw you do it...and {i}now,{/i} she won’t shut up about it.
lines.zh: : 在看见你做那件事之前，她从来不谈那些大人的事……可{i}现在{/i}，她说起来就没完没了。

lines.en: : Doesn’t that make it {i}your{/i} fault, Papa?...
lines.zh: : 那这难道不是{i}你的{/i}错吗，爸爸?……

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts10
: Big sis Chika too! She {i}never{/i} lied to Chinami before she met you! Now she does it just so she can have fun for a little while!
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐也是!在遇见你之前，她{i}从来{/i}没对 Chinami 撒过谎!现在她撒谎，就为了能开心那么一会儿!

lines.en: : And Chinami understands that big sis Chika is growing up. She understands that she’d have to be lied to eventually. She doesn’t care about that.
lines.zh: : Chinami 明白 Chika 姐姐在长大。她也明白，总有一天自己会被人骗。她不在乎这个。

lines.en: : She just doesn’t understand why everyone starts going crazy once they meet {i}you.{/i} You’re just a normal boy.
lines.zh: : 她只是不懂，为什么所有人一遇见{i}你{/i}就开始发疯。你只是个普通的男孩子啊。

lines.en: : I am {i}far{/i} from normal, Chinami. That’s why I keep breaking everyone close to you.
lines.zh: : 我{i}远{/i}称不上普通，Chinami。所以我才会不断毁掉你身边的所有人。

lines.en: : Is it really “breaking” them if {i}you’re{/i} not the one hurting them, though?
lines.zh: : 可如果伤害他们的不是{i}你{/i}，那还叫「毁掉」吗?

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts11
: Of course I’m the one hurting them. You’ve seen what’s happened to Chika ever since she started dating me. Everything just makes her sad now because I’m not as...{i}loyal{/i} as she wants me to be.
lines.zh: : 当然是我。你自己也看到了，Chika 从跟我交往之后变成什么样了。现在什么事都会让她难过，因为我没有她想要的那么……{i}忠诚{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Papa. Cause Chinami doesn’t know a lot about adult stuff, but she can definitely say that it didn’t sound like big sis Chika was {i}hurting{/i} in here.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，爸爸。Chinami 虽然不太懂大人的事，但她敢肯定，刚才在屋里 Chika 姐姐听起来可不像在{i}受苦{/i}。

lines.en: : That’s different, Chinami. It’s a lot easier to make someone feel good physically than it is mentally. I excel at that first part. I’m utterly horrible at the second.
lines.zh: : 那不一样，Chinami。让一个人身体上舒服，比让他心里舒服容易得多。我擅长前者，后者我一塌糊涂。

lines.en: : Papa makes Chinami feel good mentally all the time, though. And the way big sis Chika smiles when you’re coming over makes me think you do that for her too...
lines.zh: : 可爸爸总是让 Chinami 心里很舒服啊。而且你要来的时候，Chika 姐姐笑成那样，我觉得你对她也是一样的……

lines.en: : Where’s this even going, Chinami? What do you {i}want?{/i} Because if you’re just desperate to learn about sex, you have access to the Internet. And {i}no,{/i} that’s not an endorsement.
lines.zh: : 你到底想说什么，Chinami？你{i}想要什么?{/i}如果你只是急着想了解性，你有网可以上。还有，{i}不{/i}，我不是在鼓励你。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts12
: Chinami...doesn’t really know yet.
lines.zh: : Chinami……其实还不知道。

lines.en: : She feels sad about a lot of things right now, but doesn’t fully understand why. It’s new...and weird.
lines.zh: : 她现在对很多事都感到难过，却不完全明白为什么。这感觉很新鲜……也很奇怪。

lines.en: : Welcome to the club. We’re all miserable about something. And I know {i}I’ve{/i} been struggling to explain how I feel since before I was even your age.
lines.zh: : 欢迎加入。大家都在为某件事痛苦。而我{i}自己{/i}从还没到你这个年纪起，就一直说不清自己的感受。

lines.en: : You learned about all this adult stuff before you were Chinami’s age?
lines.zh: : 你在 Chinami 这个年纪之前，就懂了这些大人的事?

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: Something like that.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。

lines.en: : Now, are we done? Because I’d like you to go back to being the one girl that I can just entirely avoid this subject with.
lines.zh: : 那么，说完了吗？因为我希望你变回那个我可以完全不谈这个话题的女孩。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know if that’s possible anymore, Papa...
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道现在还做不做得到，爸爸……

lines.en: : Wha- Chinami?!
lines.zh: : 什——Chinami?!

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts13
: What are you doing here? You’re supposed to be at Tsukasa’s.
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？你应该在 Tsukasa 家的。

lines.en: : Chinami came back when the noise stopped. She didn’t want to watch the same movies Tsukasa was.
lines.zh: : 声音停了 Chinami 就回来了。她不想看 Tsukasa 看的那些电影。

lines.en: : Noise? What noise? There was no noise. We were just studying.
lines.zh: : 声音？什么声音？没有声音啊。我们只是在学习。

lines.en: : Then why are big sis Chika’s legs shaking so much?
lines.zh: : 那 Chika 姐姐的腿为什么抖得那么厉害?

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts14
: Because she loves to learn and there is only so much knowledge this body can hold!
lines.zh: : 因为她太爱学习了，而这副身体能装下的知识就那么多!

lines.en: : It might be time to look into soundproofing if you want to be reckless again in the future, Chika.
lines.zh: : Chika，要是你以后还想这么乱来，也许该考虑做做隔音了。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts15
: I...uh...no! Tsukasa’s the rich one! She can soundproof her {i}own{/i} room if she thinks she’s hearing things in there! Which she isn’t because nothing happened.
lines.zh: : 我……呃……不行!Tsukasa 才是有钱的那个!她要是觉得自己在屋里听见了什么，就自己去做{i}她{/i}房间的隔音!她其实什么都没听见，因为根本什么都没发生。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts16
: A-Anyway! Do you need something? I have to leave for work in twenty minutes, but I can make you some instant ramen if you’re hungry and-
lines.zh: : 总、总之!你有什么事吗？我二十分钟后就得去上班了，不过如果你饿了，我可以给你泡点方便面——

lines.en: : No thank you! Chinami will wait for Papa to buy her the fancy dinner he promised as thanks for being good and giving you two alone time.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢!Chinami 等爸爸请她吃那顿答应好的高级晚餐，作为她乖乖给你们俩留空间的谢礼。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts17
: Wait, Sensei — you did that for us? Really? That’s so sweet.
lines.zh: : 等等，Sensei——你为我们做了这个？真的吗？太贴心了。

lines.en: : Yes. I did this for us and Chinami is not subtly blackmailing me right now.
lines.zh: : 对。我是为了我们俩才这么做的，Chinami 现在没有在不动声色地敲诈我。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts18
: Awwww! So you two are gonna hang out here while I’m at work? Have a cute little daddy-daughter dinner?
lines.zh: : 哇哦!那我上班的时候，你们俩要在这儿一起玩？来一场可爱的父女晚餐?

lines.en: : Yup! That’s the plan! Chinami’s so excited to spend the night with her papa!
lines.zh: : 没错!就这么定了!Chinami 超期待和她的爸爸一起过夜!

lines.en: : Can’t wait. It’ll be a blast.
lines.zh: : 等不及了。一定会超开心。

lines.en: : You two are so cute...
lines.zh: : 你们俩真可爱……

lines.en: scene black
: I can’t believe I doubted anything for even a second...
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信自己竟然怀疑过哪怕一秒钟……

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts19
Chinami and I are left alone again when Chika leaves for work. And since I planned on spending the rest of the day here once I started heading over, I’m not {i}too{/i} beaten up about this.
lines.zh: Chika 上班去了，屋里又只剩我和 Chinami。而既然我动身过来的时候就打算在这儿耗完剩下的一天，对此我也{i}不算太{/i}崩溃。

lines.en: Sure, the amount of sex I have will exponentially decrease and reach nowhere remotely close to the sum total of all the sex ever, but it’s less travel and easier on my feet.
lines.zh: 当然，我能做的爱的次数会指数级下降，远远比不上人类历史上所有性爱的总和，不过这样少跑路，脚也舒服点。

lines.en: I just {i}now{/i} have to figure out what to do about the demon gazing up at me and trying to figure out the best way to make me uncomfortable next.
lines.zh: 我{i}现在{/i}只需要想清楚，该怎么对付那个抬头盯着我的小恶魔——她正在盘算下一步怎么让我最不自在。

lines.en: : So! What’s Papa buying for Chinami? She wants to try eel.
lines.zh: : 那么!爸爸要给 Chinami 买什么？她想尝尝鳗鱼。

lines.en: : I think Chika mentioned something about there being instant ramen here. I’ll just start boiling some water and-
lines.zh: : 我记得 Chika 提过这儿有泡面。我就先烧点水——

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts20
: Boy! Chinami sure is excited for her daddy-daughter dinner!
lines.zh: : 哇哦!Chinami 可真是期待她的父女晚餐呢!

lines.en: : It’s the one thing that will help her forget about everything that happened in this room today so she won’t blab to her big sister about it once Papa is gone!
lines.zh: : 这是唯一能让她忘掉今天这屋里发生的一切的办法，这样等爸爸走了，她就不会去跟姐姐乱说了!

lines.en: : You continue to be the most evil person I have ever met.
lines.zh: : 你依然是我见过最邪恶的人。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts21
: Then Chinami must take after you! There aren’t many people so evil that they’d have an affair in a little girl’s room after all.
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 一定是随你!毕竟能邪恶到在小女孩屋里偷情的家伙可不多。

lines.en: : Chinami-
lines.zh: : Chinami——

lines.en: : Why did you do it? Why Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么做？为什么是 Tsukasa?

lines.en: : Do you {i}love{/i} her? The same way you love big sis Chika and all of the other girls Chinami always hears her complain about?
lines.zh: : 你{i}爱{/i}她吗？就像你爱 Chika 姐姐，还有 Chinami 老听她抱怨的那些女孩一样?

lines.en: : Of course I don’t {i}love{/i} her...that’s ridiculous.
lines.zh: : 我当然不{i}爱{/i}她……太荒唐了。

lines.en: : I was just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I wasn’t in the right state of mind that night. I was self-destructing and...she was the most helpless thing I could find.
lines.zh: : 那天晚上我状态不对。我在自我毁灭，而……她是我能找到的最无助的对象。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts22
: You...wanted to take her down {i}with{/i} you then?
lines.zh: : 所以你……想拉她{i}一起{/i}下水?

lines.en: : No...it’s not like that either. I don’t...really {i}know{/i} how to describe it. {i}Why{/i} I did what I did. None of it makes any sense.
lines.zh: : 不……也不是那样。我真的{i}说不清{/i}该怎么形容。{i}为什么{/i}我会那么做。这一切都说不通。

lines.en: : Chinami’s helpless too, though. And the only time you’ve done adult stuff near her, you made her leave the room.
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 也很无助啊。而你唯一一次在她附近做大人的事，是让她离开了房间。

lines.en: : Technically, your sister made you leave the room.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，是你姐姐让你离开房间的。

lines.en: : So Papa would have let Chinami stay if the choice was his?
lines.zh: : 所以如果让爸爸自己选，你会让 Chinami 留下吗?

lines.en: : Well...
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……

lines.en: : No. Probably not.
lines.zh: : 不。大概不会。

lines.en: : I probably would have asked you to leave as well.
lines.zh: : 我大概也会让你出去。

lines.en: : But you weren’t there that night. Things might have been different if you were.
lines.zh: : 可那天晚上你不在场。要是你在，事情也许会不一样。

lines.en: : That’s the part Chinami wants to understand. Because if Papa wants to do those things with Tsukasa-
lines.zh: : 这正是 Chinami 想弄明白的地方。因为如果爸爸想跟 Tsukasa 做那些事——

lines.en: : No. Chinami, that’s not what-
lines.zh: : 不。Chinami，我不是那个——

lines.en: : Chinami thinks it’s okay.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得没关系。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts23
scene chinamiconfronts24
: Only if he’s {i}very,{/i} very careful though! Which means none of that stuff he was doing to big sis Chika in Chinami’s house!
lines.zh: : 不过前提是爸爸要{i}非常{/i}非常小心!也就是说，不准做他在 Chinami 家里对 Chika 姐姐做的那些事!

lines.en: : Understood?
lines.zh: : 听明白了吗?

lines.en: : You don’t know what you’re talking about...
lines.zh: : 你根本不知道自己在说什么……

lines.en: : You’re right! I don’t! But if you were willing to do that stuff in front of Tsukasa, Chinami thinks you’d be willing to do it {i}with{/i} her too!
lines.zh: : 你说得对!我不知道!可既然你愿意当着 Tsukasa 的面做那些事，Chinami 觉得你也愿意{i}跟{/i}她一起做!

lines.en: : No. Absolutely not. Like...I’ve been alone with you before. In the bath. And none of that has ever led to-
lines.zh: : 不。绝对不行。比方说……我以前也跟你单独待过。在浴室里。而那些从来没导致过——

lines.en: : Papa won’t even look at Chinami in the bath, which means he’s probably trying to hide something. Like him being a lolicon.
lines.zh: : 爸爸在浴室里连看都不看 Chinami，说明他大概在隐瞒什么。比如他是个萝莉控。

lines.en: : Wh...Why are you even bringing this up? Did Tsukasa put you up to it? Because her mother would-
lines.zh: : 你、你到底为什么要提这个？是 Tsukasa 让你说的吗？因为她妈妈会——

lines.en: : Nobody put Chinami up to anything. Tsukasa is very curious {i}because{/i} of you, but Chinami is more worried about what will happen if somebody {i}else{/i} gets to her first.
lines.zh: : 没人指使 Chinami。Tsukasa 是{i}因为{/i}你才变得很好奇，但 Chinami 更担心的是，如果有{i}别人{/i}先对她下手会怎样。

lines.en: : What do you mean? No one’s going to get to Tsukasa {i}first.{/i} She’s under near-constant surveillance. Anyone who’d lay a finger on her has a death wish.
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？没人能{i}抢先{/i}对 Tsukasa 下手。她几乎时刻都在被监视。谁敢碰她一根指头，那就是嫌命长。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts25
: Chinami’s just saying — if Papa wanted to teach her best friend about the birds and the bees, Chinami would keep it a secret! And Tsukasa’s {i}really{/i} into birds all of a sudden!
lines.zh: : Chinami 只是说——如果爸爸想给她最好的朋友讲讲「鸟儿和蜜蜂」，Chinami 会保密的!而且 Tsukasa 突然对鸟儿{i}特别{/i}感兴趣!

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts26
: Are you interested yet?
lines.zh: : 你现在有兴趣了吗?

lines.en: : I don’t get it...
lines.zh: : 我不明白……

lines.en: : Did Chinami get the analogy wrong? Is it bees and something else instead?
lines.zh: : Chinami 是不是把这个比喻搞错了？是蜜蜂和别的什么吗?

lines.en: : No, Chinami. I don’t get why you went from being completely oblivious to my sex life to trying to get me to {i}teach{/i} your friend over the course of two hours.
lines.zh: : 不是，Chinami。我不明白的是，你怎么会在两个小时里，从对我的性生活一无所知，变成要我{i}教{/i}你朋友。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts27
: It’s not like Chinami {i}wants{/i} to do this! She just {i}has{/i} to!
lines.zh: : Chinami 又不是{i}想{/i}这么做!她是{i}不得{/i}不这么做!

lines.en: : Why?! Don’t you understand what pushing me in this direction will {i}do?!{/i} Don’t you know how dangerous it is for me to have an {i}excuse{/i} for something?!
lines.zh: : 为什么?! 你难道不明白把我往这个方向推会{i}造成什么?!{/i} 你难道不知道，让我为某件事找到{i}借口{/i}有多危险?!

lines.en: : No! Chinami just doesn’t want to lose her friend!
lines.zh: : 不知道!Chinami 只是不想失去她的朋友!

lines.en: : So you’ll have {i}me{/i} taxidermize her instead?! And hang onto the husk that’s left of her once I {i}do?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以你宁愿让{i}我{/i}把她做成标本?! 然后等我真的{i}做了{/i}，再守着她剩下的那具空壳?!

lines.en: : Papa, no! Tsukasa’s mom is trying to get rid of her and Tsukasa is too stubborn to say no!
lines.zh: : 爸爸，不是!是 Tsukasa 的妈妈想甩掉她，而 Tsukasa 太倔，死活不肯拒绝!

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts28
: What do you mean she’s “trying to get rid of her?”
lines.zh: : 你说她「想甩掉她」是什么意思?

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts29
: Tsukasa says her mom is trying to do one of those “arranged marriage” things for her...and that she might have to marry some guy she’s never even met before...
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 说她妈妈在给她安排那种「包办婚姻」……说她可能得嫁给一个她从没见过的男人……

lines.en: : But Chinami knows Tsukasa doesn’t want that...Tsukasa just wants to be useful to somebody and...have somebody love her and care about her.
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 知道 Tsukasa 不想要那样……Tsukasa 只是想对某个人有用，想……有人爱她、关心她。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts30
: Chinami can’t get through to her, though...
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 劝不动她……

lines.en: : She won’t listen to a thing I say...
lines.zh: : 我说什么她都不听……

lines.en: : But I want to protect her from a future she doesn’t want...because the thought of her being even more sad and alone than she is now hurts.
lines.zh: : 可我想保护她，让她别陷入那种她不想要的未来……因为一想到她会比现在更伤心、更孤单，我就难受。

lines.en: : What do {i}I{/i} have to do with this though, Chinami?...
lines.zh: : 可这跟{i}我{/i}有什么关系，Chinami?……

lines.en: : How am {i}I{/i} any better than some random guy?
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}比随便哪个男人好在哪儿?

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts31
: Chinami thinks that...Tsukasa looks up to Papa.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得……Tsukasa 很崇拜爸爸。

lines.en: : That she’ll listen to {i}his{/i} advice instead of hers.
lines.zh: : 她会听{i}他{/i}的劝，而不是听她的。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : She also thinks that...
lines.zh: : 她还觉得……

lines.en: : It will be harder to arrange a marriage...
lines.zh: : 要安排婚事会更难……

lines.en: : If she’s already been.......
lines.zh: : 如果她已经被人......了

lines.en: : That happens in movies sometimes...
lines.zh: : 电影里有时候会这样……

lines.en: : A man no longer wants a girl if she’s already been with another man...
lines.zh: : 如果一个女孩已经跟别的男人在一起过，那个男人就不要她了……

lines.en: : And if Papa is interested in Tsukasa like Chinami thinks he is...
lines.zh: : 而如果爸爸真像 Chinami 想的那样对 Tsukasa 有意思……

lines.en: : She won’t tell if he wants to be that man.
lines.zh: : 如果他想成为那个男人，她不会说出去的。

lines.en: : You watch too many movies.
lines.zh: : 你看太多电影了。

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts32
: If she can say no...that’s all she has to do.
lines.zh: : 只要她能开口拒绝……那就够了。

lines.en: : Tsubasa would never force her daughter to do something like that.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa 绝不会逼她女儿做那种事。

lines.en: : But Tsukasa {i}won’t{/i} say no. She refuses.
lines.zh: : 可 Tsukasa {i}不会{/i}拒绝的。她死都不肯。

lines.en: : Then...I’ll talk to her. If she really {i}does{/i} look up to me.
lines.zh: : 那……我去跟她谈。如果她真的{i}那么{/i}崇拜我的话。

lines.en: : But that’s all.
lines.zh: : 但仅此而已。

lines.en: : But if the two of you like each other-
lines.zh: : 可如果你们俩互相喜欢——

lines.en: : Chinami.
lines.zh: : Chinami。

lines.en: : That’s all.
lines.zh: : 就到此为止。

lines.en: : We’re done with this topic. Are you ready to order food?
lines.zh: : 这个话题到此为止。你准备好点餐了吗?

lines.en: : Papa-
lines.zh: : 爸爸——

lines.en: : {i}Are you ready to order food?{/i} Or do I need to start boiling some water?
lines.zh: : {i}你准备好点餐了吗?{/i} 还是要我先去烧水?

lines.en: scene chinamiconfronts33
: Chinami’s not a baby. She knows how to boil water...
lines.zh: : Chinami 不是小宝宝。她会烧水……

lines.en: : She’ll drop it, though...as long as you promise you’ll talk to Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 不过她不提了……只要你答应会跟 Tsukasa 谈。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : I promise.
lines.zh: : 我答应你。

$ chinami_love += 1
{i}Chinami’s affection has increased to [chinami_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chinami 的好感度提升到了 [chinami_love]!{/i}
